title: Show a nonexistent issue returns a NotFound error on both backends
description: Calls issue.show against an ID that was never created on either backend. Both sides should produce a KindNotFound error; if their error classifications diverge (e.g. one reports internal, the other not_found) the harness emits an _error_kind diff. If one succeeds and the other errors, the harness emits an _outcome diff.

steps.description: Show an ID that does not exist anywhere
